name: mcp-server-for-oscal
description: AI agent tools for Open Security Controls Assessment Language (OSCAL).
long_description: Tools to explore, query, and validate NIST OSCAL content: model schemas, catalogs, profiles, SSPs, component definitions, assessment plans and results, POA&Ms, and mapping collections. Ships with bundled OSCAL schemas, documentation, and AWS component definitions, and can index your own OSCAL documents from a local directory.

oscal_documents_dir.title: OSCAL documents directory
oscal_documents_dir.description: Optional directory of your own OSCAL JSON files (catalogs, profiles, SSPs, etc.) to index alongside the bundled content.

allow_remote_uris.title: Allow remote URIs
allow_remote_uris.description: Allow tools to fetch OSCAL content from remote (http/https) URIs.

knowledge_base_id.title: Bedrock Knowledge Base ID
knowledge_base_id.description: Optional Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base ID for OSCAL documentation queries. Leave empty to use the bundled local documentation search.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: Optional AWS CLI profile used for Bedrock Knowledge Base queries.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Optional AWS region used for Bedrock Knowledge Base queries.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
